sources: Kit plan: docs/kit-batches/batch-1/chr_0035_liino.md (pass 2 and pass 3). Hit structure and frames: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0035_liino_* (game 1.6), as compiled by efsim kit-draft v2; values from SkillPatchTable (SkillData blackboard defaults where the table has none: set_cd 3, potential_atb_return 0, atb_return 5, atb_return_duration 30, talent_b 0). Stagger: each DamageAction's poiseCalculation (key poise; attack5's is onlyEnableForMainChar).

Battle skill: three timeline entries at frames 12, 14 and 16 each launch two projhit_start projectiles, each relaunching one projhit on reach (normal_skill_projhit ×1, normal_skill_projhit_02 ×5, all atk_scale: 6 × atk_scale = display_atk_scale). It creates buff_chr_0035_liino_normalskill_music_tag at frame 15 (Vocalist Stance, music_duration 60 s): its aura gives the team buff_chr_0035_liino_atkup / _atkup_owner (ATK +atk_up, stacking key liino_atk_up); buff normalskill_music_damage launches a soundwave every music_trigger (3 s, first at once) that only heals (HealAction, battle heal tag −320297214, no DamageAction); from frame 45 the AuraAction spelllnfliction_check (8 m) marks enemies (on an Arts Reaction, tag 1474064594, it also gives them spelllnfliction_hit for 2 s) and buff spelllnfliction_extraattack ticks every atk_trigger (10 s, first at once) and launches the volley from music_animation_hitl / hitr (projhit_hit, atk_scale_2, their frames 24–33) at a marked enemy within 20 m. Its tick's first condition, CheckBuffIdInContext spelllnfliction_hit, has isEnable false: no reaction is needed.

Skill descriptions (CharGrowthTable + I18nTextTable_EN). Battle skill: "While this stance is active, if there are enemies nearby, Liino will perform an Additional ATK (that deals Electric DMG to enemies) on a regular basis. [...] During Vocalist Stance, her battle skill is replaced with End Stance. Casting this will end her Vocalist Stance early without consuming any SP, after which the battle skill will enter a short cooldown." Combo: "COMBO TRIGGER: While Vocalist Stance is active, an Arts Reaction is consumed or is applied on an enemy. [...] grants HP Treatment to the controlled operator, and gains additional Ultimate Energy. Casting the combo skill Delightful Harmonics does not interrupt Vocalist Stance." Ultimate: "Cosmovoice Stance: This stance replaces Liino's Vocalist Stance. While active, the stance grants the entire team Electric Amp and Nature Amp (effects are further increased by the attribute of Will) as well as an ATK Boost. The beats of Liino's song also deal Electric DMG [...]. When the stance ends, Liino deals 3 times the DMG from a single beat [...]. This effect does not trigger if the stance is ended early."

End Stance: chr_0035_liino_normal_skill_end (no DamageAction, SkillPatchTable cost 0); normal_skill / normal_skill_combo listen for buff normalskill_end_active and run SetSkillCdAtOnce functionType 1 (set_cd, skillId chr_0035_liino_normal_skill), then JumpTo 1967. The ultimate interrupts the battle skill's action (its stance buffs are autoFinishByAction; only the combo and normal_skill_combo inherit them). After a combo in Vocalist the stance's action resumes: combo frame 67 TriggerCustomAbilityEvent liino_comboskill_end → music_tag CastSkill chr_0035_liino_normal_skill_combo. During Cosmovoice the combo runs as buff_chr_0035_liino_comboskill_ultskill_hit (combo_skill switchToBuffConfig asSkillCast, on tag −499637408 of ultskill_music_tag) beside the ultimate's action.

Talents and potentials: talent 2 (buff_chr_0035_liino_combo_atb_return, a global buff from the combo for atb_return_duration 30 s): the next battle skill (CheckSkillType [2], abilityEvent 143) of a Pulse or Nature operator returns atb_return SP, then it ends. P1: the first battle skill of the fight (buff_chr_0035_liino_potential_enterfight, lifeType 1, ended by that cast) returns potential_atb_return (25) SP; P1 also adds 0.06 to both stances' atk_up (skillBbModifier). P3/P5 multipliers, P4 cost and P2 Will come through the stat panel and skill values.

Verified (zmdlogs check): battle-skill projectiles 6/6 in fixtures/zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f.json and fixtures/zmdlogs-bdf223db8e49.json (vocalist_stance logged as buff_chr_0035_liino_atkup_owner +10% ATK); a volley without Corrosion at bdf223 t=3231–3465 matches atk_scale_2 (6 hits). Ultimate 25/25 in fixtures/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json (parser v59): 20 projectiles atk_scale, bomb atk_scale_2 with its forced Electrification, beats atk_scale_3; Cosmovoice logged as buff_chr_0035_liino_atkup_owner (ATK) and buff_common_affixes_enhance_pulse / _natural (Amp 0.410537 = will_up 0.0004 × Will 1026.34, below will_max 0.6). fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json (parser v58) doesn't log her own buffs and every hit there is under Corrosion. Combo hits are logged only under Corrosion.

Volley (in-game test 26, settled from the data and the logs 2026-11-18): a plain 10 s timer from the battle skill's frame 45, reaction or not (the data's reaction check is disabled); the logs' 103 volleys in 24 Liino logs come 10.0–11.7 s of world time apart (time stops taken out), the first 1.9 s after the stance's cast, with no reaction needed (9090afbacec9 at 2.07 and 15.22 s). Not verified (in-game tests in docs/in-game-tests.md): the combo and energy during Cosmovoice (27: the combo trigger accepts either stance; energy blocked for the whole stance), actions in the stance and End Stance's 3 s cooldown (28), End Stance as a battle skill for talent 2 (29), weapon layers per teammate (25). Basic attacks, plunging attack and finisher are from SkillData only (no fixture logs them).

buffs.label: Vocalist Stance (battle skill): team ATK

visible.why: the battle-skill button becomes End Stance

dataOverride.duration: The team buff is an aura's (until ended in its file): it lasts while the stance's music_tag aura does, music_duration (see the buff's note).

buffs.note: buff_chr_0035_liino_normalskill_music_tag (frame 15, music_duration 60 s): its aura gives the team buff_chr_0035_liino_atkup / _atkup_owner (ATK +atk_up; stacking key liino_atk_up, shared with cosmovoice_atk). Applied by the first projectile before its damage (the logs show atkup_owner on all six). Its ticks are the soundwave heals (normalskill_music_damage every music_trigger, first at once). The logs record each beat as a battle-skill cast event without damage (the owner, who plays her: presses in the stance are rare; logged gaps 3.0 s and up, and only a stance's first event has projectiles behind it): `ticksLoggedAs`. Ended by End Stance and by the ultimate (triggers end_stance, ult_replaces_vocalist). No linger: normalskill_buff_atkup's on-finish CreateBuffAction of buff_chr_0035_liino_atkup_finishtime is disabled (isEnable false; the kit had it as a 5 s team ATK until 2026-11-27, which 984748cfa662 30.11 s, 0eef2474a26f 8.74 s and 4d60e7fe92c2 73.65 s read against). The log check infers an unlogged end from her beats stopping before her basic attacks (castassembly.ts silentExits).

buffs.label: In the stance's own action (marker)
buffs.note: Liino is in chr_0035_liino_normal_skill or _normal_skill_combo, the action that maintains Vocalist Stance. Guards stance_end's endAction (the JumpTo 1967 when the stance ends), so it doesn't end the ultimate or End Stance that ended the stance.

buffs.label: Vocalist Stance volley timer
buffs.note: buff spelllnfliction_extraattack (with the AuraAction spelllnfliction_check) from frame 45 of the battle skill; ended with the stance. Ticks every atk_trigger (its triggerInterval hit_tigger, 10 s; waitFirstTriggerInterval false: the first at once): each tick launches a volley if the squad is in a fight and a marked enemy is within 20 m (the tick's reaction check, CheckBuffIdInContext spelllnfliction_hit, is disabled: isEnable false). Opened once per cast, not per beat: both are clips of the battle skill's own action (45–1691, autoFinishByAction), and the beats (buff normalskill_music_damage, its soundwave launches) and normalskill_music_tag create neither; normal_skill_combo inherits extraattack (InheritBuffAction) when a combo hands the stance on, so its clock goes on. (The data's timer ends at frame 1691, 4 s before the stance, unless a combo hands it on; approximated by the stance's end, which no tick falls between.) The game's clock for it runs slower than the replay's world time (logged volleys 10.0–11.7 s apart, mean ~10.5 s, also with no time stop between: 1d9198480e75, 891566c224f8, c6d80590f5ea), as her beats' does: `ticksShownByHits` lets the log check's replay take each tick from its logged volley.

buffs.label: Cosmovoice Stance (ultimate): team ATK

dataOverride.duration: The team buff is an aura's (until ended in its file): it lasts while the ultimate's music_tag aura does, ultmusic_duration (see the buff's note).

buffs.note: buff_chr_0035_liino_ultskill_music_tag (frame 77, ultmusic_duration 15 s) aura → normalskill_buff_atkup → buff_chr_0035_liino_atkup / _atkup_owner with the ultimate's atk_up. Same stacking key as vocalist_stance (liino_atk_up: highest only). finish_duration is 0 at every level: nothing lingers. Applied by the first projectile pair before its damage (frame 76; projectile travel isn't modelled, and the logs have the stance on every projectile).

buffs.label: Cosmovoice Stance (ultimate): team Electric and Nature Amp

visible.why: her ultimate's stance: the battle-skill button becomes End Stance

dataOverride.duration: The buff is an aura's (until ended in its file): it lasts while the ultimate's music_tag aura does, ultmusic_duration (see the buff's note).

buffs.note: Ultimate frame 77: fnlatk_up = min(will_up × Will (attribute 42), will_max) (StoreAttributeValue, CompareFloat, ModifyDynamicBlackboard), then ultskill_buff_atkup → buff_chr_0035_liino_spellenhance (EnhancedAction subType 6 and 3, logged as buff_common_affixes_enhance_pulse / _natural; stacking key liino_spellenhance). Also the kit's marker for "Cosmovoice Stance is active" (beats, finale, End Stance, combo).

buffs.label: Cosmovoice Stance: no ultimate energy
buffs.note: buff_chr_0035_liino_ultskill_refrainobtainusp (RefrainObtainUsp, lifeType 1, duration 1 s) is created by a CreateBuffAction spanning frames 77–527 with autoFinishByAction: a lifeType 1 buff lives until ended, so the block lasts the stance (pass-2 claim 6). In-game test 27 decides 15 s vs 1 s. Ended early by End Stance.

buffs.label: Cosmovoice Stance: the song's beats
buffs.note: buff_chr_0035_liino_ultskill_music_damage (ultimate frame 77, CreateBuffAction 77–477, vfx_music_duration = ultmusic_duration 15 s, triggerInterval music_damage_trigger = ultmusic_trigger 1.5 s; waitFirstTriggerInterval false: the first at once): each tick launches a soundwave. The first (at once, at frame 77) is the ultimate's first_beat (trigger ult_song: on the cast's own frames, so the log check's placement times the ultimate by it, as its projectiles travel); the kit buff ticks from one interval on (trigger cosmovoice_beat). It outlives its creating clip: the logs have 10 beats per Cosmovoice (all ten logged in 4bfc6f3e84b8 at 55.3 s, 4d60e7fe92c2 at 82.6 s, 984748cfa662 at 53.5 s; never 11), the 10th at 482; it ends at 527 without the tick due then (noTickAtEnd; the engine's ticking buffs tick on their end frame by default, as Rossi's bleed does). Ended early by End Stance. The logs place the beats on a clock of their own against the ultimate's frames (logged 1.17–1.89 s apart without a time stop; 4d60e7fe92c2 a steady 1.36 s in both its Cosmovoices while its projectiles and Zhuang Fangyi's strikes keep their frames to ±15 ms, c6d80590f5ea 1.52 s): `ticksShownByHits` lets the log check's replay take each beat from its logged hit, and the song's end with them (one clock: 4d60e7fe92c2's second Cosmovoice, its beats pinned 1.36 s apart, had two replay-only beats past its ninth logged one while the song ran on to 15 s).

buffs.label: Cosmovoice ended early by End Stance (marker)
buffs.note: End Stance during Cosmovoice jumps the ultimate's timeline to 540 (its EventListenerAction), past the finale's launch at 508: the finale doesn't come. Lasts the stance's 15 s, past any finale it skips and before the next ultimate (its cooldown is longer).

buffs.label: Starry Boost (talent 2): next Electric or Nature battle skill returns SP
buffs.note: global_buff_liino_combo_atb_return → buff_chr_0035_liino_combo_atb_return, created by the combo after its frame-33 hit while talent 2 is learned (talent_b 1; 0 without the talent, so the buff isn't applied). Recasting the combo refreshes it (no stacking).

stacks.label: P1: first battle skill of the fight returns SP
stacks.note: buff_chr_0035_liino_potential_enterfight (lifeType 1), made when the fight starts without the Vocalist tag and used up by the first battle skill (normal_skill frames 0–2). Its SP is potential_atb_return, 0 below P1.

Cosmovoice counts too: the text names only Vocalist, but both stances add the same entity tags and the combo has a Cosmovoice variant (in-game test 27).
The "Arts Reaction is consumed" half of the combo trigger.
Battle skill frame 45: AuraAction spelllnfliction_check and CreateBuff spelllnfliction_extraattack.

hits.note: Launched by buff normalskill_music_animation_hitl / hitr at its frames 24–33 (projhit_hit, atk_scale_2); logs: pairs at +0 / +107 / +234 ms.

Logs: bdf223db8e49 volleys at t=3231 and 14699, 0eef2474a26f at 4187; the 2× volleys of 1d9198480e75 (442, then 886) are the team's buffs (Ardelia's Arts Susceptibility 0.28 and Arts DMG Taken 0.16, Arcane's WILL 0.096, the usp02 set's DMG 0.16) by its second volley at 13.7 s: plain matches.

The ultimate interrupts the battle skill's action, whose stance buffs are autoFinishByAction; the ultimate has no InheritBuffAction. Description: "This stance replaces Liino's Vocalist Stance".

triggers.note: The ultimate's first beat, at its frame from the cast (the other beats are cosmovoice_song's ticks: cosmovoice_beat; the finale is the ultimate's own hit). A trigger's hit, so the log check's placement times the ultimate by it (as its projectiles travel) and its key's later landings go to cosmovoice_beat.

hits.label: Song beat

dataOverride.count: Each beat launches two soundwave projectiles (two LaunchProjectileActions in buff ultskill_music_damage's event); the logs show one hit per beat on one enemy (zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d: 4 of 4), so the kit has one.

hits.note: A soundwave at each tick of cosmovoice_song (buff ultskill_music_damage's buffEvent 1) from the second beat on (frame 122; the first is ult_song's first_beat). Each also heals (ultimate heal tag). Only enemies in the AOE are hit: the logs have 4 beats in ~7.4 s (dbaee23) and 3 (d9e59). Verified per beat: zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d 4/4. Until 2026-11-22 fixed frames of the ultimate (122–482, 45 apart).

triggers.note: Each tick of cosmovoice_song launches a beat (9: frames 122–482). End Stance ends the song with Cosmovoice (trigger end_stance), so no beat comes after it.

Ultimate frame 77: the music_tag aura (team ATK, Amp) and the energy block's CreateBuffAction (77–527) and the song (cosmovoice_song, 77–477) start; the song's first tick comes after them in the frame, so the first beat lands under Cosmovoice. Until 2026-10-31 on the first projectiles' landing, which the log check pins to its logged time: dbaee23b801d's Arcane at 8258 / 8501 ms had none of it (×1.5).
Ultimate frame 80: buff ultskill_music_heal_start (team heal, ultimate heal tag −1499119779). Nothing can cut the ultimate before frame 137 (cantCastSkill channel).

Ultimate frame 513: buff ultskill_music_heal (team, ultimate heal tag). Skipped when End Stance ended Cosmovoice (JumpTo 540): End Stance ends the ultimate's action, which drops this delayed action (the only other skill that could, her combo, runs beside it). Not written as `if: buffActive cosmovoice_amp`: advance() runs a buff's expiry (frame 526) before a delayed action due earlier (513) when one step covers both.

End Stance: after Vocalist, SetSkillCdAtOnce functionType 1 sets the battle skill's cooldown to set_cd (3 s, SkillData default; not in SkillPatchTable); the ultimate has no such listener. Ending Cosmovoice early skips the beats still to come and the finale (their if).
normal_skill frame 0: FinishBuff potential_enterfight, CheckSquadInFight, ObtainCostAction costType 1 potential_atb_return (0 below P1, 25 from P1).
combo_skill CreateGlobalBuffAction global_buff_liino_combo_atb_return after the frame-33 hit.

buff_chr_0035_liino_combo_atb_return: abilityEvent 143, CheckSkillType [2], caster's charType Pulse or Natural → ObtainCostAction costType 1 atb_return, FinishGlobalBuffAction. Liino's own battle skill and End Stance count (sub-skills count as battle skills: in-game test 29); her normal_skill_combo follow-up doesn't (followUp: false).

hits.label: Finale (3 × a beat)
hits.note: The ultimate's own hit (until 2026-11-22 trigger ult_song's, under buffActive cosmovoice_amp as it landed). Not after End Stance in Cosmovoice (cosmovoice_cut: the game's JumpTo 540 skips its launch); else it lands wherever the log check's replay pins it to its logged landing, Cosmovoice's own end in the replay or not (a launch frame, KitHit.launch, would hold her combo beside the ultimate until it: the engine doesn't cut a cast's own hits before their launch): the logs have it 14.3–14.75 s of world time after the first beat (the kit 14.37 s: the ultimate's timeline, not the song's clock: 4d60e7fe92c2's ten beats took 13.0 s), while the replay's own time stops left it 0.8–2 s early (9090afbacec9, 891566c224f8, 4bfc6f3e84b8). Frame 508: atk_scale_4 = atk_scale_3 × final_value (SimpleCalcBB; final_value 3), then the soundwave_02 projectile. Logged 3 × a beat (4d60e7fe92c2 13043 against 4348, 9090afbacec9 7294 against 2431). Skipped when the stance is ended early (End Stance → JumpTo 540).
